policy: Donor files were read at their pinned commit in the local mirror (tools/mirrors.py), as data; nothing was run. Ideas only, in westack's own words; no donor text is copied (skills/westack/provenance/RIGHTS.md). The component classification is skills/westack/provenance/absorption.json (gstack.retro).

usefulness_legend.strong: shaped the skill's structure or its metrics
usefulness_legend.useful: added a rule or a check

donors.system: gstack retro and its global discovery script

sources.read: lines 53-327 (window, guard, metric list, sessions, types, hotspots, sizes, focus, team, trends, streaks) and the global-mode headings
from the 2026-11-04 inventory: discovery from Claude Code, Codex and Gemini session logs

taken.mechanism: Windows aligned to local midnight, the date taken from the session rather than the clock, and a stale-window guard that stops instead of reporting a quiet week.

Metrics from git history: commits with merges apart, lines as context, the test share, commits weighted by files with a cap, active days, sessions split at a 45-minute gap into deep, medium and micro, conventional-commit types and the fix ratio, commit size buckets, the hourly spread, the focus share of the busiest folder, hotspots, the biggest commit, per-contributor rollups, AI co-authors counted apart from people, and streaks anchored at the newest commit.
Features shipped counted only from the changelog and merged pull requests, unavailable rather than zero without a source.
A comparison with the previous window or the last saved retro, and a global mode that finds repositories from local agent session logs.
Per-person praise tied to a commit and one data-backed growth note; a solo repository skips the team section.

rejected: A metrics script that runs git itself: westack helpers run no command; the agent saves one documented git log and the helper parses it.
The gbrain context load, the factory scorecard, the review-bot signal, the shortcut-debt ledger and the skill-usage and eureka logs: gstack's own state or services.
Saving retro history inside the repository by default: history goes where the user says.
